transformations: Sorted games by the raw millisecond timestamp ascending.
Converted each raw timestamp to a calendar date in America/Chicago.
Copied opponent, result, and note text verbatim from the saved logs collection.
Expanded deck IDs to readable names using the artifact HTML declaration for its built-in decks and the corresponding checked-in brew deck filenames/lists for brew-06 and brew-06b.
Used the custom deck label Skarmory ex / Chandelure recorded in the saved review that read the same Ladder Log snapshot.
limitations: The CSV is a point-in-time export of the complete saved logs collection read on 2026-09-25 UTC; games added to the live artifact afterward are not included.
Opponent archetype spelling and capitalization are user-entered and intentionally not normalized.
Only the requested calendar date is exported; the source retains millisecond timestamps.
